source_window.dataset: OS NGD Building Features — free sample data

first_missing_criterion: Record-level official/public OS NGD Building Features feature for Exeter from the free sample GeoPackage, with physical building footprint geometry and record-bound Building Use/Description attribution. The distinct Ordnance Survey sample-data catalogue confirms an Exeter vector sample for OS Building Features in GeoPackage/CSV format (September 2025), but the sample package payload could not be dereferenced through the available retrieval channel (cache miss) before any feature record could be read; therefore no individual building record was accepted and no geometry or type/use value was inferred.
